title: Processable microporous membranes: emerging platforms for separation technologies
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,2229-2264
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00543D, Review Article
Shuwen Yu, Ying Chen, Zhihua Qiao, Jingwei Hou
Processability has emerged as a critical requirement for translating microporous materials into scalable membrane technologies, yet many porous frameworks remain difficult to fabricate as large-area, defect-free membranes.
